prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: first opponent character portrait study for the PC game Evolution Wars.
Create a polished horizontal character expression sheet, 1536x1024 canvas, three equally sized adjacent panels on the same plain near-black navy background. Each panel shows the SAME man from mid chest upward, identical face scale, eye level, framing, hairstyle, clothing, lighting and anatomy. No text, no frames, no lettering.
Character: Nico Valdes, fictional Cuban man aged 34 from Havana, an audio equipment repair technician trying his first evolution-strategy tournament. Warm medium brown skin, short slightly untidy dark wavy hair, light neatly imperfect stubble, friendly rounded-angular face, natural adult proportions, slightly asymmetrical eyebrows, expressive warm brown eyes under normal eyelids. Attractive in an ordinary approachable way, relaxed and easy company, not glamorous or intimidating. Faded burnt-orange short-sleeve overshirt open over an off-white T-shirt, subtle seam wear, small unbranded wired earbud hanging from collar. No hat, no sunglasses, no headphones on head, no cigar, no flags, no tropical tourist styling.
Character performance: reads as a likeable beatable beginner, not stupid. Panel 1: relaxed shoulders, small confident closed-mouth smile, body very slightly toward viewer right (the arena), attentive eyes. Panel 2: same pose but slight single-eyebrow lift and tiny pursed lips, a moment of 'wait, why did my plan do that?' without exaggerated shock. Panel 3: same pose with warm modest sheepish grin, good sport who has learned something, small natural teeth exposure.
Art style: refined 1990s–2000s PC strategy/adventure game pixel portrait, mature illustrated realism translated into deliberate crisp square pixel clusters, controlled limited color palette, readable blocks of skin color, understated facial texture, no noisy dithering, no glossy 3D, no anime, no huge eyes, no bobble head. Pixel detail comparable to an approximately 160x200 native portrait enlarged with nearest-neighbor, composed to read well in a small square UI crop. Restrained highlights, warm orange and cream clothing against dark navy. Face silhouette and chin remain consistent across the three expressions. Leave clear space around hair and shoulders.
status: concept study; runtime sprites not exported
